description: Create an empty Origin-hosted repository. Pick an owner from list_namespaces where viewerCanCreateRepositories is true; omit owner to use the caller's personal namespace, which Origin claims on first use (needs an eligible plan, a Privacy Mode that allows code storage, and no team membership; team members pass their team slug). Both steps are one approval: confirm with the user before calling. defaultBranch defaults to main, and visibility defaults to internal; pass private when the user asks to limit the repository to explicitly granted people and groups. Repository names are unique per owner, so retrying after a success fails with a conflict; read the repository with get_repository instead. Returns the created repository, including cloneUrl.

defaultBranch.description: Default branch name. Omit for main.

name.description: Origin repository name within that namespace

owner.description: Origin namespace (owner) slug, taken from list_namespaces or an earlier Origin result. A GitHub owner or org name is not an Origin namespace unless list_namespaces returns it.

visibility.description: internal (visible to members of the owner) or private (only explicitly granted people and groups). Omit for internal.
